snippet.title: LSS Demo99   Trim
snippet.description:
Last Ship Sailing is a fast, zero-gravity ship combat game where every match feels like a neon cyberpunk dogfight inside a living sci-fi arena. Pick your ship, launch into twisting tunnels and open chambers, and fight to be the last fleet standing.

It is a classic 6DOF arena combat with modern chaos: glowing weapon trails, cockpit HUDs, shield bursts, rockets, smoke, explosions, reactive music, ship AI callouts, and wild class abilities that can flip a fight in seconds. You can play cross platform multiplayer, flat-screen on PC or XboxX, jump into VR on Quest 3, or fight solo with bots when you just want instant action.

Feature List 
- Zero-gravity ship combat with full 3D movement 
- Playable in flat-screen or VR 
- Quest 3 support, with Medium settings now running especially well 
- Solo mode with bots 
- Team battles: Fleet A vs Fleet B
 - Round-based matches with score tracking
 - Cinematic team intro before combat 
- Seven distinct ships: Puncture, Slayer, Vortex, Tracker, Syphon, Pyro, and Blaster 
- Unique weapons for every ship 
- Multiple abilities per ship 
- Powerful core abilities for big momentum swings
- Rockets, missiles, railguns, blasters, fire weapons, stuns, shields, traps, and siphon attacks
- Lock-on systems and missile salvos 
- Cockpit-style HUD with health, shields, ammo, abilities, core meter, speed, and warnings 
- VR HUD mirrored from the flat-screen HUD 
- Reactive procedural soundtrack
- Ship AI announcer callouts - Dynamic explosions, sparks, smoke, shield effects, and weapon trails 
- Destructible obstacles and environmental effects 
- Multiple arena/map styles 
- Custom location / Google Maps-style arena option
- Ship selection screen with 3D ship previews 
- Gamepad support 
- Keyboard and mouse support 
- Rebindable controls 
- Performance settings for different devices 
- Sound settings, music settings, announcer settings, and visual settings 
- Multiplayer lobby structure is present, with solo play ready for quick matches 
- Built to feel big, bright, fast, and dramatic without needing an install.

See you on the battlefield, Pilot! LSS.FractalReality.ca
